test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘AGENT’ is coded as ZHGOG and ‘CHAIR’ is coded as XICJI. How will ‘FAITH’ be coded in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/227382320f62201d48d7d33815a575fe6cd3654400af11269d3317765f6713aa.png] 

**Logic:** First and last alphabet's opposite letter is written, (1) is added in the second and fourth letter and (2) is added in the third letter.

AGENT is coded as ZHGOG →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8306bca2ab450be5f2b850f61cb0d5ae3915bffc61b54959155043cd2fdd4eef.png] 

CHAIR is coded as XICJI →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1db3bcdb18600c86fb23e98ec2887d23d6a401da4502ca72306894b84ff9be4a.png] 

Similarly, 'FAITH' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286df5f898d4446257a604f5d263e9bc10e29c50efaba4040320ec3ef72b4f59.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "UBKUS".
